verdict.rationale: No evidence item names anomaly or outlier detection. The only related support is the Knowledge Graph 'generating insights about issues... no complex queries required' and the Kubernetes Overview that 'surfaces what needs triage', which only imply automatic problem surfacing without hand-written thresholds. Missing for 10: explicit anomaly/outlier detection feature docs, a description of how baselines or ML models replace static thresholds, integration of such detection into alert rules, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
